target.title: fix: surface terminal agent run failures
target.body:
## Summary
- return a marked failure reply when an agent run reaches a terminal failure with no visible payload and no committed source delivery
- preserve the existing success path when the agent already produced visible content, delivered via the message tool, or needs the existing model-capacity formatter
- add regression coverage for fallback-exhausted and completed-terminal-error cases

## What Problem This Solves
Terminal embedded-agent failures can mark the hidden reply operation as failed while still flowing onward without a visible payload. On chat surfaces this can leave a user-triggered turn with no visible source reply, which looks like the bot ignored the message even though the run failed internally.

## Evidence
Local validation on this PR branch:

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts`
  - 1 shard passed, 224 tests passed
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts`
  - completed with no findings
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test`
  - completed successfully

The added tests cover both terminal failure shapes: fallback exhaustion with no visible payload/delivery, and completed terminal error with no visible payload/delivery. They also cover the negative case where source delivery already happened, so the new guard does not duplicate a reply.

## Test
- node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts
- pnpm exec oxlint src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.ts src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts
- pnpm tsgo:core:test
